Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Google Cloud, Terraform and Kubernetes. If you enjoy the challenge of working with globally distributed clusters in an environment where security and scalability are taken seriously, this role is for you.

Our team has invested in a stable, observable platform. The next step is to scale that foundation. That means moving more workloads onto IaC, hardening our security posture, and preparing our services for rapid user growth. This is a hands-on role in a small, senior, fully remote team. You will own services end to end, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help other teams become self-sufficient. If you like keeping things simple, standard, well automated and monitored, come talk to us.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain our Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, with the goal of having all production infrastructure defined as code and reviewed through pull requests. 

  • Run and evolve our Kubernetes (GKE) clusters, including cluster upgrades, capacity planning, autoscaling, networking and workload isolation.

  • Migrate remaining manually deployed services onto Kubernetes, with documented and repeatable deployment flows.

  • Consolidate configuration, access and user management across Google Cloud projects into a single source of truth.

  • Keep separate, clearly bounded environments for internal services, partner workloads and future community facing services.

  • Partner with the other internal teams to move their infrastructure onto infrastructure as code and Kubernetes.

  • Keep GitHub Actions secure and efficient: pinned dependencies, least privilege tokens, sensible runner usage and controlled costs.

  • Maintain and extend our metrics, logging and alerting stack so that every service has metrics, logs and actionable alerts.

  • Apply least privilege access across Google Cloud, Kubernetes and GitHub, and review temporary admin rights regularly.

  • Contribute to the team's quarterly and yearly roadmap and give realistic estimates, including proposing discovery periods for complex projects.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering roles, including at least 2 years running production workloads at a senior level.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production, including deployments, networking, upgrades, autoscaling and troubleshooting.

  • Strong experience with Terraform, including module design, state management and managing multiple environments.

  • Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (GKE, IAM, networking, Pub/Sub or similar managed services).

  • Experience setting up and operating observability tooling for metrics, logs and alerting in Grafana (or similar) stack.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions, and building and running containerised services with Docker.

  • Good understanding of security best practices, including secrets management, IAM and least privilege access.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals comfortable scripting Bash.

  • Experience migrating manually managed services onto infrastructure as code.

  • Able to work independently in a fully remote, async team, prioritise your own work and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Google Cloud certification (for example Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) or a Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKS).

  • Experience running infrastructure for environments with strict security requirements.

  • Experience with push notification infrastructure (Firebase Cloud Messaging, APNs) at scale.

  • Familiarity with peer-to-peer or distributed systems.

  • Familiarity with Node.js services and how to run them in production.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to embed directly within one of our engineering teams. This is not a traditional QA seat. You’ll be expected to understand the architecture of our product, reason about quality from first principles, and build the test infrastructure our engineers depend on — not just execute test cases against it.

You’ll work day to day alongside an engineering manager and PM, owning a defined scope of quality coverage across our Web3 and exchange integration flows. You write production-quality code, build and maintain automation frameworks, and use AI tooling as a core part of how you work.

Responsibilities

  • Embed directly within an engineering team and work alongside its EM and PM
  • Read and understand the codebase and product architecture, then design quality scenarios from that understanding — not just from tickets or specs
  • Build, own, and maintain automated test frameworks in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C# — from scratch where needed, not just extending what exists
  • Write and maintain E2E, API, and integration tests across Mesh’s Web3 and exchange integration flows using Playwright or Cypress
  • Build and maintain automated API test suites covering schema validation, auth flows, and mocking of third-party failures
  • Build and maintain mobile automation test suites across iOS and Android using Appium, XCUITest/Espresso, Maestro, or equivalent
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and own the health of those pipelines
  • Run recurring regression sweeps and maintain ongoing test coverage discipline independently
  • Write clear, reproducible bug tickets in Linear with crisp reproduction steps and supporting evidence
  • Communicate proactively with engineers and product managers — flag quality risks before being asked, not after
  • Use AI tools to accelerate test authoring, framework development, and coverage analysis — and bring your own point of view on how to do that well

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience combining software engineering and quality engineering — you write code, not just test cases
  • Proficiency in at least one of: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C# at a level where you can build and own automation infrastructure, not just script individual tests
  • Hands-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch with Playwright and/or Cypress — framework ownership, not inherited usage
  • Mobile automation testing experience across iOS and Android: hands-on with Appium, XCUITest/Espresso, Maestro, or equivalent frameworks
  • Automated API testing depth: has built and maintained API test suites (Playwright API, REST Assured, Pytest, Postman/Newman, or equivalent) covering schema validation, auth flows, and mocking third-party failures
  • Experience integrating and maintaining automated test suites in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar)
  • Crypto fundamentals on day one — testnets, wallets, gas, and why a transaction fails without the gas token. We want to skip the onboarding that past hires needed
  • Working knowledge of core Web3 flows: wallet connections (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect), transaction signing, and on-chain vs. off-chain behaviour
  • Experience testing third-party/exchange (CEX) integrations end-to-end (e.g. Coinbase-style connect flows)
  • API testing depth — schema validation, auth flows, mocking third-party failures, cross-layer data consistency
  • Comfortable working async across US/Europe/India time zones — proactive, picks up work and drives it without someone sitting with them
  • AI fluency: active daily user of AI development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) with real opinions on where they help and where they fall short

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing dApps, smart contract interactions, or on-chain state validation
  • Testnet usage (Sepolia) or Web3 provider mocking in a test environment
  • Prior experience as the first or sole QA/SDET at a startup — built a quality function from scratch
  • Experience configuring AI agents or MCPs for QA-specific automation tasks

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.

Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About Ramp Labs

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money.

About the Role

Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet.

You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map-reduce, long-running fan-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production.

What You’ll Do

  • Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step

  • Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping

  • Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output

  • Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine-tuned models where they hold up

  • Turn one-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack

  • Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works

What You Need

  • Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped

  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent or high-fan-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map-reduce over models, large batch inference

  • Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production

  • Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look like before you scale the swarm, and you can separate signal from agent noise

  • The habit of measuring: cost, yield, false-positive rate, and whether a change actually helped

  • Ownership: you can run a roadmap and a production system with little oversight

  • Clear written communication

Nice-to-Have

  • Built agent orchestration or job systems (Ray, Temporal, Modal or custom)

  • Used LLMs to search large spaces: codebases, document sets, logs or other large corpora

  • Post-training or hosting open-source models for high-volume inference

  • Distributed systems background

  • Public work we can look at: an agent framework, an open-source project, a write-up or a paper

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the India Startups team

India is producing a new generation of SaaS companies, digital-native businesses, platforms, marketplaces, and AI-first startups with global ambitions. These businesses need more than a payments provider. They need financial infrastructure that can support rapid growth, international expansion, new products, and increasingly complex business models.

The Startups Grower team helps Stripe’s largest and fastest-growing startup users realize more value from Stripe. We combine commercial ownership with deep curiosity about our users’ businesses. We work with founders, CFOs, product leaders, and engineering teams to understand where they are going next, then bring together the right people and products across Stripe to help them get there.

This is an opportunity to shape how Stripe serves India’s most ambitious technology companies. You will join a focused, entrepreneurial team in Bengaluru while working closely with colleagues across Stripe’s global Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations organizations.

What you’ll do

You will own and grow a portfolio of high-potential startup customers. Your goal will be to build trusted, long-term relationships, retain and expand existing revenue, and help users adopt the Stripe products that best support their next phase of growth.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of each user’s business model, growth plans, technical architecture, and financial infrastructure
  • Build trusted relationships with founders and senior stakeholders across finance, product, engineering, and operations
  • Create account plans that identify retention risks, expansion opportunities, decision-makers, and clear paths to measurable user value
  • Lead renewals and commercial negotiations with a focus on durable partnerships, strong outcomes for users, and responsible revenue growth
  • Identify and close opportunities for additional product adoption, new use cases, deeper integrations, and international expansion
  • Run thoughtful discovery and product conversations that connect Stripe’s capabilities to outcomes such as revenue growth, improved conversion, fraud reduction, faster launches, and greater operational efficiency
  • Manage a portfolio with rigor, using data to prioritize accounts, forecast accurately, and focus time on the opportunities with the greatest potential
  • Design and execute scaled campaigns for groups of users with similar needs while maintaining a high-quality, consultative experience
  • Coordinate across Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Product, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations to resolve complex issues and set users up for long-term success
  • Bring structured feedback from Indian startups to Stripe’s Product and leadership teams, helping improve our products, positioning, and market strategy
  • Build relationships across India’s startup ecosystem, including founders, investors, accelerators, and technology communities

What success looks like

In this role, success means:

  • Retaining and growing a portfolio of strategic startup users
  • Increasing adoption of relevant Stripe products and use cases
  • Building senior, trusted relationships that extend beyond a single transaction or renewal
  • Identifying opportunities early and leading them to a clear commercial outcome
  • Creating a predictable, high-quality operating rhythm across account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and execution
  • Helping Stripe better understand and serve high-growth companies building from India for the world

Who you are

We are looking for a commercially strong, intellectually curious account executive who enjoys helping high-growth companies solve important problems. You can move comfortably between a founder conversation, a technical discovery session, a pricing discussion, and an internal strategy review. You are equally comfortable going deep on a small number of strategic opportunities and executing at pace across a broader portfolio.

If you meet the minimum requirements, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are helpful, but they are not required.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in account management, consultative sales, customer growth, or another client-facing commercial role, including meaningful experience in the Indian market
  • A demonstrated track record of retaining and expanding relationships with technology companies or other complex B2B customers
  • Experience leading renewals, upsells, cross-sells, or multi-product commercial negotiations
  • Strong discovery skills and the ability to translate business and technical priorities into relevant solutions
  • Ability to build credibility with founders and senior stakeholders across finance, product, and engineering
  • Strong commercial judgment, including comfort with pricing, business cases, contracts, and competing customer priorities
  • Analytical discipline and the ability to use data to prioritize a portfolio, build account strategies, and forecast accurately
  • Experience coordinating complex work across multiple internal teams
  • Ability to operate with ownership and sound judgment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, or financial infrastructure
  • Experience working with venture-backed startups, digital-native companies, SaaS businesses, platforms, marketplaces, or businesses expanding internationally
  • Existing relationships within India’s founder, venture capital, accelerator, or technology ecosystem
  • Familiarity with APIs, online payments, subscription business models, fraud prevention, platforms, or cross-border commerce
  • Experience working in a global organization with geographically distributed teams
  • Experience with spreadsheets, CRM analytics, SQL, or a demonstrated willingness to learn

Why this role matters

India’s most ambitious startups are building products for customers across the world. In this role, you will help those companies develop the financial infrastructure they need to scale, while shaping Stripe’s relationships and long-term growth in India. The work combines commercial impact, technical problem-solving, ecosystem building, and the opportunity to partner with some of India’s most exciting founders and technology teams.

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage
